Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 63-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGluca (dose: 50mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-01-19.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter672@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
